texts.content: {"text": "운행 시 차선 확인 어려움!", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.49411764705882355, 0.7215686274509804, 1.0]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "size": 12.33, "effectStyle": null, "range": [0, 15], "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "shadows": [], "bold": false}]}

{"text": "혼잡한 도로에서 사고 발생 확률 UP!", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.4235294117647059, 0.6509803921568628, 1.0]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "size": 15.01, "effectStyle": null, "range": [0, 21], "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "shadows": [], "bold": false}]}

{"text": "옵틱글래스 광각미러로 한방에 해결!", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 0.9019607843137255, 0.23137254901960785]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "size": 12.33, "bold": false, "effectStyle": null, "range": [0, 19], "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "shadows": []}]}

{"text": "초보운전자에게는 특히나 치명적인 좁은 시야!", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "strokes": [], "size": 7.5, "useLetterColor": true, "range": [0, 24], "shadows": [], "effectStyle": null, "bold": false}]}

{"text": "운전고수도 무시할 수 없는 사각지대!", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 0.7215686274509804, 0.9019607843137255]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "size": 12.33, "effectStyle": null, "range": [0, 20], "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "shadows": [], "bold": false}]}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "range": [0, 18], "shadows": [], "size": 7.5, "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "effectStyle": null, "bold": false}], "text": "사각지대 해소 가능한 넓은 시야,"}

{"text": "광각미러가 꼭 필요한 이유", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "size": 10.45, "bold": false, "effectStyle": null, "range": [0, 14], "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "shadows": []}]}

{"text": "혼잡한 도로에서도 걱정 없이 안전한 운전", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "size": 12.33, "bold": false, "effectStyle": null, "range": [0, 22], "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "shadows": []}]}

{"text": "비가 오나 눈이 오나 쾌적한 시야 제공", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.49411764705882355, 0.7215686274509804, 1.0]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "size": 12.33, "bold": false, "effectStyle": null, "range": [0, 21], "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "shadows": []}]}

{"text": "옵틱글래스로 교체하고 언제나 안전한 운행", "styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 0.9019607843137255, 0.23137254901960785]}}}, "font": {"id": "61E809AD-5A9E-5413-926C-EFC549816E89", "path": "C:/Users/bssho/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts/Paperlogy-7Bold.ttf"}, "size": 12.33, "bold": false, "effectStyle": null, "range": [0, 22], "useLetterColor": true, "strokes": [], "shadows": []}]}
